whenToUse: Overall satisfaction with a product, place, or content.
It will be compared with others' ratings.
whenNotToUse: Rating several aspects in detail (use rating tags or reviews).
Finer scales such as 0 to 10 (use a rating slider).
Only displaying a rating (use a rating badge).
accessibility: Build it from a fieldset and radio buttons so the arrow keys change the score.
Each option has a name such as 4 stars or 4.5 stars.
The star graphics are aria-hidden, and the score is also shown in text.
The focused star shows an outline.
